newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds remain subdued in afternoon.
newsitem.headline: European feeds remain subdued in afternoon.

text.p: Despite a stronger Chicago soycomplex futures opening and a weaker dollar the European meals and feeds market remained subdued this afternoon, market sources said.
"There was little buying interest today with lower seller prices, there seems to be no faith in the market. We saw only a few nearby trades," one broker said.
June Argentine sunmeal pellets traded $1.50 lower at $124 a tonne cif Rotterdam.
EU sunmeal changed hands at 19.50 marks per 100 kg fob Amsterdam.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
